forecast.summary: One system will be moving late this afternoon and lasting through Monday morning, bringing mainly cloudy skies and very light flurries. The sun reappears from Tuesday on with a benign and generally seasonable pattern for the rest of the week. Lows Tuesday night through Thursday night will be near -10 C in the alpine with cold low-level temperatures and mainly clear skies.

text.summary:
Strawberry Chair is now open for laps on Dell Valley! The gondola starts loading at 8:30 am, with Strawberry and the Mitey Mite carpet opening at 9:30 am. Enjoy early season turns and the rail park on lower Strawberry while our team works to open more lifts and runs as conditions allow.

Save some energy for a few “laps” at Mad Trappers, open from 10:30 am. Visit our Early Season page for what’s open, operating hours and lift ticket prices.

text.summary:
Your Sunday on Snow

3 lifts, 4 runs and 2 small terrain parks are open today. Start with groomed laps on Bald Eagle and Juniper off Glacier Chair, or ride Juniper Chair for Easy Street and the parks. The Magic Carpet is running in our dedicated Learning Area for anyone finding their feet on skis or a snowboard.

With a little more help from Mother Nature, we’ll be able to open more terrain. In the meantime, our crews are getting the first lifts and runs on the upper front side ready. Stay tuned for opening updates.

Save 50% on early-season lift tickets, available online and at the resort. Winter lift hours are 9:30 am to 4:30 pm daily. Details here.
text.lifts_info: Glacier Chair is open today, serving the Bald Eagle and Juniper runs. Juniper Express Chair is also open with access to Easy Street, and the Magic Carpet is running in the Learning Area. More terrain is coming soon, as conditions allow.
